action_items: Backend suite has no app-specific tests; v1 acceptance flows are intentionally client-side and no API-bearing criterion was present.

checks.criterion: Home page presents the Renewable Energy Explorer shell and routes to the interactive areas
checks.name: home-shell-navigation
checks.evidence: Home shell and hero rendered; browser navigation reached Solar Tracker, Electricity Journey, Calculator, and Power the City via toolbox cards.

checks.criterion: Smart Solar Tracker updates outputs immediately from dual-axis/sun controls
checks.name: solar-tracker-controls
checks.evidence: Angle slider changed offset from 18° to 45° and current output changed; reset restored 18°; output and comparison panels visible.

checks.criterion: Electricity journey is a clickable accessible source-to-device explanation
checks.name: electricity-journey-stages
checks.evidence: Six stage buttons rendered; Device control accepted focus/click and active title/detail updated to Device explanation.

checks.criterion: Personal calculator validates inputs and shows transparent estimates
checks.name: calculator-validation-estimate
checks.evidence: Negative electricity input showed inline rejection and invalid message; reset restored result; LPG edit changed total; factor disclosure visible.

checks.criterion: LPU case study clearly communicates illustrative assumptions
checks.name: lpu-illustrative-case-study
checks.evidence: Persistent non-official-audit disclaimer, editable students input, modeled output update, methodology, and reset verified.

checks.criterion: Power the City game has learnable turn/day mechanics
checks.name: power-city-game-mechanics
checks.evidence: Reset, solar build, budget dashboard, day advance/weather status, and local persistence across reload verified.

checks.criterion: Information hub and sources surfaces are complete and accessible
checks.name: information-hub-and-sources
checks.evidence: Seven topic controls rendered; Green hydrogen selection updated detail; About navigation exposed methodology, limitations/review checklist, privacy boundary, and placeholder source register.

checks.criterion: Survey is a safe placeholder with no in-app collection
checks.name: survey-safe-placeholder
checks.evidence: Placeholder, no-response-records, and privacy messaging visible; external link verified as https://forms.google.com with target=_blank.
